The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field, with hints of red and white colors, likely spectators or stadium elements.

To verify that the red stitching is topologically connected to the leather surface and does not exhibit 'floating' artifacts or edge bleeding common in AI generation.
To assess the photorealism of the leather texture and the naturalness of the depth-of-field blur in the background.
